result.response:
The bug has been identified and fixed.

### Root Cause
In [`ControlFlowAnalysis.computeFollowNode`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_c_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L764-L770), when coming out of a `FINALLY` block (`parent.getLastChild() == node`), CFG edges to parent finally blocks were being added as `Branch.UNCOND` instead of exception edges (`Branch.ON_EX`). This caused the missing return statement check to falsely report missing returns when exiting try-finally structures.

### Fix
Changed `Branch.UNCOND` to `Branch.ON_EX` in [`ControlFlowAnalysis.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_c_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L767):
```java
          if (cfa != null) {
            for (Node finallyNode : cfa.finallyMap.get(parent)) {
              cfa.createEdge(fromNode, Branch.ON_EX, finallyNode);
            }
          }
```

### Verification
Ran `mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest`, which passed completely:
